root_cause: The engine never reserved inline boxes: a WidgetSpan was shaped as a literal U+FFFC with the span style, and the widget tree had no child slot for inline widgets.
change: crates/incular-text/src/engine/inline.rs (new: TextPlaceholder, TextPlaceholderBox, Parley InlineBox mapping with SkParagraph Run::updateMetrics alignments, middle centring on the font's ascent/descent); crates/incular-text/src/engine.rs (layout_rich_with_options, U+FFFC shaped as zero-width U+200B at the same byte offsets, TextLayout::placeholders, cluster walk steps over boxes so carets after a box follow it, boxes shifted by snap_line_boxes and dropped by clipped_layout); crates/incular-text/src/spans.rs (TextSpan::placeholders; RichText::layout reserves boxes); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/descriptors.rs (RichParagraph with child(id, widget), InlinePlaceholders; From<RichText> reserves childless spans' sizes); layout/behavior/text.rs (children laid out with BoxConstraints(maxWidth), their size and baseline fill the box, children offset to the placed boxes); plumbing in specs.rs, tree.rs, structure.rs, constructors.rs, lowering/visual.rs, render_object/update.rs, devtools_props.rs, lib.rs
harness: text__widget_span_layout: match (was 220x19 vs 220x40); diagnostic twin now uses RichParagraph with the blue ColoredBox child
api_change: Additive: RichParagraph, InlinePlaceholders, TextEngine::layout_rich_with_options, TextPlaceholder/TextPlaceholderBox, TextLayout::placeholders (new pub field), TextSpan::placeholders. WidgetSpan is unchanged (id + size + alignment).
limitations: Intrinsic width/height queries ignore inline boxes; a child whose box was clipped or ellipsized is left at the paragraph origin and still painted (Flutter skips it); the text scaler does not scale WidgetSpan children (_AutoScaleInlineWidget); ideographic placeholder baselines are not modelled; U+FFFC shapes as U+200B, so line breaking around a placeholder follows ZWSP rules.

root_cause: TextEditingController::with_text wrote a collapsed caret at the end; Flutter's TextEditingController(text:) and the text setter leave TextSelection.collapsed(offset: -1) until a selection, an edit or EditableText focus (_handleFocusChanged collapses an invalid selection at the end).
change: crates/incular-text/src/editing.rs: ControllerState.selection_unset, set by new(), with_text() and set_text(); cleared by any selection, edit, value or restoration (an unset-to-set transition notifies even with equal offsets); new selection_if_set() and collapse_unset_selection(); selection() unchanged. crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/text.rs set_focused: a text field gaining focus calls collapse_unset_selection().
harness: text__editable_initial_selection_focus, word_arrow_selection, home_end_shift_select, backspace_delete, multiline_vertical_document: match (Incular twins read selection_if_set, -1 when unset)
api_change: Additive: selection_if_set(), collapse_unset_selection(). selection() keeps returning the collapsed end for existing callers.
limitations: from_value(TextEditingValue::new(..)) stays set (TextEditingValue::new still stores a collapsed end, unlike Flutter's default -1). Default::default() controllers start set.

root_cause: StrutStyle existed only as a type; Text had no strutStyle and line metrics ignored it.
change: crates/incular-text/src/engine.rs: TextLayoutOptions::strut (TextStrut, part of the layout cache key), TextEngine::resolve_strut (strut font ascent/descent, height scaling proportional or even), apply_strut in engine/inline.rs widens (or with force_strut_height replaces) each unrounded line box before snap_line_boxes. crates/incular-widgets: Text::strut_style, RichParagraph::strut_style, lowered with the text scaler applied to the strut size (unset size = 14) and resolved at layout.
api_change: Additive: Text::strut_style, TextLayoutOptions::strut / field strut, TextEngine::resolve_strut, TextStrut.
limitations: Strut leading (StrutStyle.leading) is not modelled (no field; Flutter's default is 0). An unset strut family falls back to the text's family.
note: Was source-only; now covered by a new scenario.

root_cause: RawAutocomplete was a static descriptor that lowered to its child.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/forms.rs RawAutocomplete section: retained _RawAutocompleteState (options, last text, highlight, showing, selecting); options_builder run on text change, options view in an OverlayPortal under the field (field width, from its bottom edge, inside a TextFieldTapRegion), shown while focused with options; KeyboardListener with Up/Down, PageUp/PageDown (4), Ctrl/Cmd+Up/Down, Escape (hide, else fall through); onFieldSubmitted selects the highlighted option; select sets display text with a collapsed caret, calls on_selected and closes; AutocompleteHighlightedOption::of(context). Default field view is an EditableText under Focus(node). lib.rs exports the builder type aliases.
api_change: Additive builders: options_builder, options_view_builder, field_view_builder, text_editing_controller, focus_node, on_selected; AutocompleteHighlightedOption::of. new(options, display) keeps working (unfiltered static options).
limitations: Only opens down (no optionsViewOpenDirection); selecting the same option again is not deduplicated (T has no PartialEq bound); no semantics announcement; initialValue not supported.
note: Source-only finding; verified with tree-level tests.
